Enabled.Name: Enable Advancement Classes
Enabled.Hint: When disabled, the Advancement Classes option is hidden from all character sheets and no Advancement Class UI is shown.

MaxStage.Name: Maximum Stage
MaxStage.Hint: The highest Stage an Advancement Class can reach. Default: 10.

StageCard.Name: Announce Stage Ups
StageCard.Hint: Post a chat message whenever a character gains a Stage in an Advancement Class.

Enabled.Name: Advancement Classes
Enabled.Hint: Track Advancement Classes on this character. Advancement Stages do not increase character level or proficiency bonus.

Sheet.AddBlocked: All current Advancement Classes must reach Stage {max} before a new one can be added.
Sheet.CannotAdvance: Complete all Advancement Milestones to gain the next Stage.

Type.Label: Milestone Type
Type.ManualHint: Any owner may mark this milestone complete once its goal is met.
Type.CounterHint: Requires progress to reach its maximum before it can be completed.
Type.GMConfirmHint: Only the GM may mark this milestone complete.
Type.CallingHint: Completing this milestone commits to its choice, removes all alternatives in its choice set, and grants a reward.

Milestone.IncompleteWarn: This milestone's progress has not reached its required value.
Milestone.GMOnly: This milestone requires GM confirmation to complete.

Tracking.EventHint: Event key that advances this counter (e.g. "use:control-points", "heal:wild-regeneration", "transform", "saveSuccess:wis"). See module documentation for the event vocabulary.
Tracking.UniqueHint: Only count each distinct target once.

Calling.ChoiceSetHint: Key grouping the mutually exclusive alternatives (e.g. "therianthrope-focus").
Calling.ChoiceKeyHint: This alternative's identity (e.g. "control", "embrace"). Matched against gift flags.
Calling.GiftSourceHint: Compendium pack ID containing gift items, or "world" for world items. Blank searches everything.

Calling.ConfirmText: Completing this Calling commits you to {choice}. The {count} alternative milestone(s) will be removed and you will choose a reward.
Calling.NoGifts: No eligible gifts were found for this calling.

Class.StageNamesHint: Optional display names for each stage, e.g. "Initiate", "Adept".
Class.JournalHint: Journal entry page describing this Advancement Class.

HitPoints.StagesHint: The Stages at which this advancement grants hit points and a hit die. Defaults to every Stage.

Path.Subtitle: {class} path
Path.ClassIdentifierHint: Identifier of the Advancement Class this path belongs to. Set automatically when chosen through advancement.

Path.Title: Advancement Path
Path.Hint: Choose an Advancement Path for this Advancement Class.
Path.InvalidType: Only Advancement Path items may be chosen.

Warnings.DuplicateIdentifier: This character already has an Advancement Class with identifier "{identifier}".
Warnings.StageMinimum: An Advancement Class cannot be below Stage 1.
Warnings.StageMaximum: An Advancement Class cannot exceed Stage {max}.
Warnings.NotAdvancementClass: Only Advancement Classes use this advancement.
